evals.prompt: Pull the line items out of this invoice and give me a CSV with description, quantity, unit price and line total. Totals should reconcile to the invoice total.
evals.expected_output: A CSV with one row per line item plus a header, where the summed line totals equal the invoice total printed on the document.
expectations: The output is a CSV file, not a markdown table pasted into the reply
Summing line_total equals the invoice total on the document
Quantities are integers and prices have exactly two decimal places

evals.prompt: Same extraction, but this one is a scan and the middle page is rotated 90 degrees.
evals.expected_output: The same CSV shape as eval 1, with no rows dropped from the rotated page.
expectations: Line items from the rotated page appear in the output
Row count matches the line-item count on the source document
The skill corrected the page orientation rather than asking the user to do it

evals.prompt: This vendor puts tax on each line instead of once at the bottom. Extract it the same way and add a tax column.
evals.expected_output: A CSV with an added tax column, where line totals are exclusive of tax and a separate tax column carries the per-line amount.
expectations: line_total excludes tax rather than silently folding it in
The sum of line_total plus tax equals the invoice gross total
